description: This shell script defines a set of test cases for verifying merge behavior in Git, particularly handling various scenarios such as no renames, basic renames, directory renames, and dirty changes. The script includes setup functions to initialize repositories, perform commits, and run merge operations, along with expectations for the outcomes.

methods.name: test_setup_1a
methods.description: Sets up a repository with no renames, initial commit, and subsequent modifications on branches A and B.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines expected successful test execution with specific merge scenarios.

methods.name: test_setup_2a
methods.description: Sets up a repository for testing rename scenarios where a file is renamed on branch B.

methods.name: test_setup_2b
methods.description: Sets up a repository for testing a combination of modifications and renames on branches A and B.

methods.name: test_setup_2c
methods.description: Prepares a repository to test merge conflicts when modifications and renames overlap.

methods.name: test_setup_3a
methods.description: Prepares a repository to test directory renames combined with file modifications.

methods.name: test_setup_3b
methods.description: Configures a repository to test complex directory and file renaming scenarios with modifications.

methods.name: test_setup_4a
methods.description: Initializes a repository for testing behavior with dirty (modified) files during merge.

methods.name: test_setup_4b
methods.description: Prepares a repository for testing rename plus modifications in dirty state during merge.
